setup: cd "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH" && find . \( -name node_modules -o -name .git -o -name actions-runner \) -prune -o -type f -name '.env*' ! -name '*.example' -print | while read -r f; do [ -d "$PASEO_WORKTREE_PATH/$(dirname "$f")" ] && cp -n "$f" "$PASEO_WORKTREE_PATH/$f" && echo "copied $f"; done; true
